_comment: The maps of CardBrix the game and the doors that link them. Read by the client (client/src/lib/game/maps.js) AND by the server plaza (src/services/gamePlaza.js), which keeps players of different maps apart and lets a player change map only while standing at a linking door. Spawns are the only places a player can appear at when entering a map (by a door or when coming back from the site). The plaza size and start point are also in gameWorld.json (a test keeps them equal).
